How it works

Say no to fuel and electricity bills

ECO units run on a battery. An alternator regulates the system and charges the battery automatically while the unit runs.

22hrs

Daily use

Up to 22 hours of use every day.

8yrs

Battery life

The battery lasts about 8 years before it weakens.

0carbon

Smokeless

No harm to people or animals.

Safe to install indoors or outdoors.

Nigeria Operations

Built for quiet places

Silent operation designed for peaceful residential, office, healthcare, and commercial environments. Based in Oko Erin, Kwara, serving homes, businesses, and industrial facilities across Nigeria.
